verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only single outbound calls via POST /v2/create-phone-call and account-level concurrency quotas, including reserved inbound concurrency that caps outbound traffic. Neither shows a batch outbound campaign feature with scheduling or per-campaign throughput controls. The 'batch testing' mention is about test simulations, not call campaigns, and the single-call API and concurrency caps are only building blocks or adjacent controls.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
